rules.text: The 11th lord aspects the 11th house while the 10th is free of malefic occupation and aspect: a leading place among those close to power — senior rank in government or a large organisation.
The ascendant lord and the 10th lord exchange houses: a strong combination for association with rulers and people in authority.
